head: e024766d
verdict: #887 REPRODUCES, but NOT as filed: the freeze is inside the sweep instrument's own source-scan step, not in any tool call. The mechanism is NOT established.

observations.result: same freeze point every time: scans=377, steps=13

reproduced.determinism: scans=377 and steps=13 were identical across 6 instrumented runs; the sweep stops at cell 3 (callee `forEach`)

localization.method: throwaway copy (script/m59/tmp-matrix-diag.ts) with a heartbeat, per-step logs and per-file logs; the canonical script/m59/matrix-tool-language.ts was never modified
localization.next_statement: for (const l of calledLines(src, c.name)) realCallLines.push({ rel, line: l })
localization.conclusion: the freeze is between the successful read of the 78th slice file and the instrument's own calledLines() predicate
localization.calledLines_is_pure: true — indexOf + char tests only; no I/O, no regex, no child process, no await

product_tool_path_REFUTED_as_cause.probe: script/m59/probe-inproc-block.ts (same walk as the matrix, same slice, same process that just indexed)
product_tool_path_REFUTED_as_cause.significance: the two handlers the matrix calls (bb_graph, bb_analyze) answer in milliseconds for the same callee on the same slice in the same process — so '#887 tool calls block for minutes' is not supported

frozen_process_state.sample_integrity: FIRST samples targeted the wrong PID (pgrep|head -1 matched stale processes whose own heartbeat interval kept them alive forever). Only the launches that captured the parent PID at start are trustworthy.
frozen_process_state.cpu: 0% of a core (measured over 6-8s via /proc/PID/stat utime+stime, all threads)
frozen_process_state.wchan: inconsistent between samples: ep_poll (event loop idle) and anon_pipe_read (blocking pipe read)
frozen_process_state.honest_note: the inconsistency is not resolved; neither reading is sufficient and no mechanism is claimed

separate_product_facing_observation.finding: an indexer forked worker remains alive and RUNNING at high CPU after the index run reports completion
separate_product_facing_observation.evidence: run m, during the freeze and with no kill issued beforehand: parent 244744 (bin/tsx, 0 CPU, 43s etime) and its child 244755 (node --require tsx, state R, 00:00:31 CPU at 43s etime ~= 72% of a core); the index had reported 'kotlin - Exposed: 150 files indexed in ~14-20s' well before
separate_product_facing_observation.status: OBSERVED, not yet root-caused; deserves its own issue (worker lifecycle / leaked pool worker)

retracted_this_round: TRIGGER IS TWO LANGUAGES IN ONE PROCESS - refuted: kotlin alone at 150 files freezes identically
'user 0.84s proves the process did no CPU work' - unreliable: a worker orphaned by the harness kill escapes bash time accounting (a worker with 2m52s CPU was observed surviving)
'runaway orphan worker is a product defect' - at least partly a harness artifact, since kill -9 on the parent orphans the fork
'blocked in anon_pipe_read' - sampled the wrong PID at least once; cannot be stated as fact
a [scan] log patch temporarily deleted 'const src = linesOf(rel)' and produced a ReferenceError, i.e. a self-inflicted false hang
pkill -f <pattern> matched this session's own shell and killed the command - never used again
no_change_claimed: No fix is proposed or claimed: the mechanism is not established, and an instrument that hangs must first be made incapable of hanging silently (watchdog + per-step and per-cell bounds), which is the recommended next action.
